cim: Our View: Schools need clear boundaries for artificial intelligence
cim_eredeti: Our View: Schools need clear boundaries for artificial intelligence
szoveg_eredeti:
Artificial intelligence is changing how students learn and how teachers teach. Schools need to figure out how to use it without allowing the technology to take over the work of education.

In the Lake Havasu Unified School District, students already use computers throughout their school years. High school students receive laptops for schoolwork, and district policies limit the use of artificial intelligence to certain teacher-guided activities. But as AI becomes more common, school leaders face questions about where it belongs in the classroom and how much students should rely on it.
